_readme: Topic backlog for the daily writer. The planner picks an open topic from the most under-served pillar, prefers fresh trend topics, and rotates formats. Add ideas freely; set status to 'open'. The weekly trend scan appends researched topics with sources. 'used' items are kept for de-duplication.
